Keeps vehicles, materials and people out of the vent area so a blowdown does not damage equipment or scatter stored items.

Mounted on the fence or post at the base of the station blowdown stack.

Midstream compressor station operators, gas control technicians, station mechanics and maintenance leads at natural gas compressor stations.
